verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents CUDA/cuTile as a public programming API for the GPU (docs-17–20), giving developers a way to programmatically drive the hardware's compute capabilities, and there's a developer portal (llms.txt) hinting at machine-readable docs. However, there's no evidence of an agent-friendly, structured API (no OpenAPI/swagger spec found, docs.md 404) tailored for AI-native/agentic control of the card's features like DLSS or Reflex. Missing for 10: a structured/machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/swagger), evidence of agent-callable endpoints for GPU features, and independent confirmation of AI-native API usage.
